issues: Snow Bridge scene: streetlight 0xffcc66 is ~5500K warm yellow - Y2K dark-cyan requires cool (<5000K) illumination
Brown #8B4513 used for fragment counter and as CSS variable - warm earth tone violates cold palette rule
Blizzard Street: dark red/purple palette (0xcc2233 emergency, 0x1a1015 fog) creates warm red undertone instead of cold cyan

size_issues: counters.css line 6: #emotion-bar, #infection-bar font-size: 11px - borderline, should be >= 12px
strengths: 4 Y2K-compliant font families loaded: VT323 (pixel), Silkscreen (pixel), Share Tech Mono (monospace), Orbitron (tech display)
image-rendering: pixelated set globally on body element
Custom SevenSegment font-face for counter displays
System font stack fallback is monospace

hierarchy_issues: Mac OS 9 / QuickTime window panel metaphor is period-correct for Y2K
Layout is centered symmetrical (dialog-panel centered, input-panel centered) - Y2K liminal benefits from mild asymmetry
No brutalist offset elements - all panels aligned to center axis
strengths: Large Three.js background fills entire viewport creating negative space
Dialog panel at 50% height leaves breathing room above and below
System dialog and popup use distinct z-layers creating depth

lighting_issues: Rain Underpass: fog near 20-80 too close for deep liminal effect
Snow Bridge: no volumetric fog, black fog (0x000000) reduces depth
Fog Highway: FogExp2 density 0.0006 too light - distant objects still visible
Blizzard Street: fog (0x1a1015) has warm purple tint instead of cold cyan

per_scene_notes.notes: Strongest liminal scene. Fog present, cool ambient, single distant warm window creates isolation. Rain particles (600 drops, additive blending) add atmosphere. Cracked concrete floor with flat shading reinforces PS1 aesthetic.

70% dead black requirement is atmospheric but warm streetlight breaks cold palette. Snow particles at 0xffffff are too bright - should use pale cyan. Streetlight flicker effect adds unease. Missing fog depth reduces liminal quality.

Best technical implementation. FogExp2 creates continuous depth falloff. Dashed center lines at 30% opacity fade into fog correctly. Light poles with distance-based opacity reinforce fog depth. Fog particles (300, additive blending) create volumetric atmosphere. Highway light at 0xaaccff is cold cyan - ideal.

Good technical elements: fog present, snow + grain dual particle system (innovative). Film grain overlay via 3D points (200 particles, 0.25 opacity, additive blending) is creative but should be CSS overlay for consistency. Dark red emergency light creates tension but warm red palette conflicts with Y2K dark-cyan.
